- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Adds the core building blocks that dynamic context parallelism needs at runtime: TP × runtime-CP process groups, resolution of the runtime CP group a scheduled batch records, and CP sharding of padding masks. Nothing here changes how training is configured or scheduled.

This is part 1 of 7 of a split of #7047, made so that each PR needs at most three CODEOWNERS reviewer groups. Original changes by @xiaoyao0115 in #7047, building on @zhongbozhu's zhongbozhu/Megatron-LM@a708518.

**Changes**

- `parallel_state`: builds the TP × runtime-DPxCP group for every runtime CP size (`get_dynamic_tensor_data_context_parallel_group`). Converting CP layouts after sequence-parallel scattering communicates over this group. With TP1 it is the dynamic DPxCP group itself. These communicators are created only when dynamic CP is enabled with TP>1; their first in-tree user arrives in part 4.
- `core/utils.py`: `_resolve_dynamic_cp_group_for_batch` resolves the runtime CP group from a batch's `local_cp_size` (or a group it already carries) and checks the sizes match. `get_batch_on_this_cp_rank` now resolves that group for every dynamic-CP batch, including the real singleton group when CP is off for a microbatch, and shards with per-sequence balancing. Per-document balancing also works on pipeline stages that carry only labels or padding masks.
- `context_parallel/utils.py`: padding masks are sharded with the batch in every CP layout (padded slots stay masked), and `get_batches_on_this_cp_rank` resolves the dynamic group once before building layout views.

## The split

| # | PR | Reviewer groups | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core building blocks for runtime dynamic-CP groups (this PR) | core-adlr, core-nemo | — |
| 2 | Layout-specific padding masks in the hybrid stack | core-adlr, core-nemo, hybrid-model | 1 |
| 3 | Packing-aware dynamic-CP scheduler | core-adlr, core-nemo, datasets | 1 |
| 4 | Dynamic CP on the standard train and eval schedules | core-adlr, core-nemo, training | 3 |
| 5 | Retire `HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper`; alias `hybrid_context_parallel` | core-adlr, core-nemo, datasets | 4 |
| 6 | Remove the legacy hybrid-CP pipeline schedule | core-adlr, core-nemo, pipeline-parallelism | 5 |
| 7 | Allow CP layout conversion with the packing scheduler | core-adlr, core-nemo, transformer | 2, 4, 5 |

The remaining PRs open as their dependencies merge. Applied in order, the seven PRs reproduce #7047 rebased onto current main, plus fixes for problems found while splitting it; each fix ships in the PR whose code it corrects. This PR adds tests for the runtime-group resolution, which #7047 left untested.

Linked issue: related to #7047.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests (`test_parallel_state.py`: TP × runtime-CP group sizes with TP2; `test_get_batch.py`: runtime CP group resolution, including the singleton group and inconsistent metadata, and padding-mask sharding on a pipeline stage without token tensors)
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the autoformatter on my PR

+def _resolve_dynamic_cp_group_for_batch(
+    batch: Dict[str, Any],
+    hybrid_cp_group_func: Optional[Callable[[int], torch.distributed.ProcessGroup]],
+) -> torch.distributed.ProcessGroup:
+    """Resolve and validate the runtime CP group recorded by a scheduled batch."""
+    local_cp_size = batch.get('local_cp_size')
+    if local_cp_size is None:
+        raise ValueError("local_cp_size is required for dynamic context parallelism")

+    runtime_cp_group = batch.get('hybrid_cp_group')

+            raise ValueError("hybrid_cp_group_func is required to resolve the dynamic CP group")

+    if runtime_cp_group is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"No dynamic CP group exists for local_cp_size={local_cp_size}")
+    runtime_cp_size = runtime_cp_group.size()
+    if runtime_cp_size != local_cp_size:

+            f"group has {runtime_cp_size} ranks, metadata requests {local_cp_size}."

+    """A CP-off microbatch (local_cp_size == 1) resolves and records the singleton group."""

+        patch("torch.distributed.get_world_size", side_effect=lambda group: group.size()),
